mapper.update: UPDATE classification_settings SET next_request_at=CASE WHEN next_request_at > #{next} THEN next_request_at ELSE #{next} END WHERE id=1
UPDATE classification_settings SET revision=revision WHERE id=1

UPDATE classification_settings SET enabled=#{c.enabled}, endpoint=#{c.endpoint}, model=#{c.model}, secret_encrypted=#{c.encryptedKey}, timeout_seconds=#{c.timeoutSeconds}, interval_seconds=#{c.intervalSeconds}, revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classification_assignment a JOIN media_song s ON s.id=a.song_id WHERE a.tag_id=t.id) AS song_count FROM classification_tag t ORDER BY t.dimension,t.name,t.id
mapper.update: UPDATE classification_tag SET name=#{name},aliases_json=#{aliases},active=#{active},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM media_song ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE classification_song SET revision=revision+1,state_json=#{state} WHERE song_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM classification_history WHERE song_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE classification_history SET reverted=1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM classification_task ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM classification_item WHERE task_id=#{task} AND status=#{status} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classification_item WHERE task_id=#{task} AND status=#{status}
SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS n FROM classification_item WHERE task_id=#{id} GROUP BY status

SELECT i.* FROM classification_item i JOIN classification_task t ON t.id=i.task_id WHERE (SELECT next_request_at FROM classification_settings WHERE id=1) <= #{now} AND t.status='RUNNING' AND t.next_at <= #{now} AND i.status='PENDING' ORDER BY t.created_at,i.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE classification_item SET status='CANCELLED',error='任务已终止，未继续分类',updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
UPDATE classification_item SET status='PENDING',error='服务重启，等待管理员继续',updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE classification_task SET status='PAUSED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='RUNNING'
UPDATE classification_task SET status='PAUSED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='RUNNING'
